description: Final-manuscript update: successor-training, staleness and tau2-bench studies merged into the paper; tau2-bench 2B<-4B shared pool; post hoc analyses; November registrations; README rewritten. The manuscript/ LaTeX source was removed from the repository (paper: arXiv:2610.38610). No new inference during packaging.

cd experiments/posthoc && python headroom.py .. ../../followup/repair_budget TMP/hr   # == headroom.md, headroom.json
